name: Apollo 11 (Tranquility Base)
notes: Lunar Module position. LROC elevation -1926 m (datum not confirmed); M3 takes height from the DEM. Plan V8 uses the older NSSDC value 0.67408, 23.47297 (only metres apart).

name: Apollo 12

notes: Lunar Module position. Landing date still to fill from NSSDC table.

name: Apollo 16 (Descartes Highlands)
notes: Lunar Module position. NSSDC lists the landing as 20 Apr 1972 (US date); confirm the UTC date before filling.

name: Apollo 17 (Taurus-Littrow)
notes: Lunar Module position from the LROC 2016 coordinate update.

name: Chang'e-4 (Von Karman crater)
notes: Liu et al. 2019 (used by plan test V6); source elevation -5935 m. Alternative LROC stereo-DTM value: lat -45.4561, lon 177.5885 (https://www.lroc.asu.edu/images/1100), about 0.4 km away. Far side: Earth never visible.

name: SLIM (near Shioli crater)
notes: LROC position of the lander, elevation -912 m (datum not confirmed). JAXA target site (stated as ME): lat -13.31549, lon 25.24889 (https://global.jaxa.jp/press/2024/01/file/jaxa_doc01_20240125_e.pdf).

name: IM-1 Odysseus (Malapert A)
notes: NASA/LROC value, 2 decimals, elevation 2579 m (datum not confirmed). Finer NAIF CLPS kernel value: lat -80.12759, lon 1.44587 (https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/pds/pds4/clps/clps_spice/spice_kernels/fk/clps_to2im_im1_v02.tf). Landed on a ~12 degree slope, about 1.5 km from the intended site.

name: IM-2 Athena (Mons Mouton)
notes: CHECK: needs a primary source (NASA or LROC) for the actual touchdown point. LROC intended site: lat -84.78, lon 29.13 (https://www.lroc.asu.edu/images/1401). Intuitive Machines says it landed about 250 m from the intended site, in a ~20 m crater.

name: Blue Ghost M1 (Mare Crisium)
notes: CHECK: this is the nominal target site, not a confirmed touchdown point. LROC rounds the actual landing to about 19 N, 62 E; look for the precise value at https://www.lroc.asu.edu/images/1400.
